intelligence.essence: The presentation's formatting carries to every other page — but only after the presentation is done. Go into each policy page and put the frame around the text, formatted with the same formatting as the presentation, same voice, same feeling, one by one — and wait until the presentation is finished first, because the formatting has to exist before it can be carried. The same carry applies on the first frame itself: the footer links at the very bottom (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Refund Policy, Acceptable Use, Community Guidelines, Copyright/DMCA, Ambassador Terms, Membership & Billing, Young Citizens) — a small scroll down to see them — each using the same intelligent-board language inside the frame to speak the intelligence of each one. And every link on the first screen is checked by actually following it.
